name: population_phenotype_basal
title: Basal-condition physiology — v2ecoli baseline vs experimental literature
question:
Does the v2ecoli baseline single-cell→division ensemble reproduce the
basal-condition physiology of glucose-minimal MG1655 — growth rate, biomass
yield, glucose uptake, central-carbon fluxes, exchange rates, proteome census,
macromolecular composition, and metabolite pools — when graded against curated
experimental + theoretical reference values rather than a pinned run?

variants.name: wild-type baseline (no perturbation)
variants.detail: Unperturbed glucose-minimal whole cell; the vs_literature reference is experimental data, not a pinned run.

model_settings.name: literature-reference-side
model_settings.detail: Reference values read live from ecoli_sources.VALIDATION_BUNDLE_PATH (the validation manifest, bypassing the ParCa SourceBundle contract).

assumptions.text:
The committed model_*.json fixtures faithfully represent the blessed baseline
ensemble (post-burn-in gen≥3) — so grading the fixtures reproduces the verdict
the live sweep would give (reversible: a later study.run_zarr_paths() drop-in).

tests.name: growth-rate-in-band
tests.question: Is the ensemble growth rate μ within the measured band?

measure.detail: μ (1/h) from per-cell doubling times; graded vs the curated measured band.

tests.name: glucose-uptake-below-band
tests.question: Does the model under-consume glucose relative to the measured band?

tests.name: biomass-yield-first-principles-violation
tests.question: Does the biomass yield exceed the theoretical-max stoichiometric ceiling?

measure.detail: Yxs = ΔDW / ∫(q_glc·DW)dt by direct mass balance; exceeds the theoretical_max ceiling → differentiated first-principles violation.
